Admission/writer/download/ZIP/manifest/inventory/content readers all enforce that same installed table before allocation/writes, incrementally and at completion. Missing registration/over-cap rejects; no prior555MB substitution, dropped copies, automatic growth or remote-first cycle.

The staged chain is non-circular: source interface approval, implementation and bounded measurement, independently bound cap registration/re-freeze when needed, current complete source proof, separately authorized source artifact, actual target declaration/download/LOCAL proof, then authorized private CI and original-host combined Gate. Future artifact IDs/bytes are not prerequisites for writing source code; they remain real prerequisites at target declaration/local acceptance. No gate or threshold is weakened.

Platform API precision remains mandatory. The parent's real old run observation has empty pull_requests/referenced_workflows and does not supply workflow_ref/workflow_sha fields. This Norm does not assert those fields exist: it requires separate authenticated repo/PR/commit/workflow-blob/run/attempt/job/Check/head association and rejects missing/ambiguous/inaccessible facts. Implementation must derive those coordinates from trusted actual associations, retain evidence and fail closed if it cannot; it may not fill them from artifact JSON, environment or a self-reported RuntimePlatform object. API feasibility/download permission and completed future target proof are not claimed by this design review.
